intro: Every Maze Guardians story starts as a drawing. These are the original sketches that inspired Issue #1 — shown exactly as they were drawn, only trimmed and resized for the web.

items.title: The Stretch-Punch
items.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: a big figure with three green dragon heads on his helmet stretches his arm across the page to bonk a flying stick figure, while two sword-carrying figures shout 'attack!!' and another yells 'ahh'
items.note: The very first Dragoncrest — and the moment the Glitchlings learned to bounce.

items.title: Stretch-Punch, Take Two
items.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: a second version of the Stretch-Punch scene with a slightly different neck on the giant hero
items.note: A second take on the same scene. Comics call this an instant replay.

items.title: Robo-Beast Roar
items.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: a huge grey robo-beast roars next to a tall tower with a crash, while little stick figures below shout 'Yikes'
items.note: The sketch that introduced Grumblejaw — complete with roar, crash and a well-earned 'Yikes!'

items.title: The Wave Ride
items.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: four stick-figure heroes travel along the back of a blue sea serpent on a wave over purple sand, with a crescent moon in the sky
items.note: Where Splashfang found out he makes an excellent surfboard.

items.title: Yeti Showdown
items.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: under a yellow sun, a colourful team of heroes — an archer, a hero in a blue shield, a speedster with zigzag legs and others — faces a giant labelled 'Yeti' in the snow
items.note: The whole team's first big battle. Arrowlight, Bubbleguard, Zigzag and Blizzardbyte all started here.
